text:
ben: scheduling tenant_metadata backfill for tonight 23:00 UTC in the change window. pinning deploy tag redis-v2.3.4, please ack if any objections :eyes:
alice: quick Q — are we doing a full table scan or batched LIMIT loops? last time locks spiked during the final phase
carol: plan is batched LIMIT 5000 with sleep between batches. will use an id-range cursor to avoid long txns. snippet:```python
# pseudo
while True:
  rows = fetch_next(5000)
  update_rows(rows)
  sleep(2)
```
ben: exact SQL will be the same as preflight:```sql
BEGIN;
UPDATE tenant_metadata SET flags = flags || '{"migrated":true}' WHERE migrated IS NULL LIMIT 5000;
COMMIT;
```
carol: also enabling prefix KV cache on model-serving route during backfill to reduce tail latency, unrelated but FYI
sam: @ben @carol I can watch the window. set me as pager for 23:00-00:30 UTC. rollback criterion: if 95th latency > 250ms for > 5min OR >0.5% 5xx on write path we abort and rollback the migration job
ben: noted. deploybot will post the scheduled job in this thread
DeployBot: Migration job scheduled by ben for 2024-11-07T23:00:00Z — job id: mig-20241107-tnmeta-01. Tagged release: redis-v2.3.4. Canary: tenant-sample-42 (2 nodes)
alice: two small asks: 1) include a feature-flag gate so we can stop applying to new tenants mid-flight, 2) add a safepoint to pause after tenant shard 120
carol: both done. feature flag: ff.tenant_meta_backfill, safepoint shard logic in runner (watcher will post status every 5m)
ben: release notes (short): "tenant_metadata: add migrated flag for analytics and rollout gating. Backfill scheduled 23:00 UTC. Batched, id-cursored, feature-flag gated. Rollback criteria posted in channel."
carol: ops checklist: preflight DB replica lag < 5s, cores < 80% for writer, read-replica catchup verified. if any check fails, hold and reschedule
sam: I'll run preflight at 22:30 and post PASS/FAIL here. If FAIL, we abort and re-pin next available window
ben: TL;DR ack thread: please react :thumbsup: once you reviewed. I'll flip the release pin at 22:45 and enable the safepoint hook.
alice: :thumbsup:
carol: :thumbsup:
sam: PASS @ben preflight checks green. ready to proceed, will monitor
DeployBot: mig-20241107-tnmeta-01 transitioned to STARTING at 2024-11-07T23:00:05Z
carol: canary nodes completed first 10k rows, no elevated locks, continuing
sam: noticing a small bump in p99 write latency ~180ms but within threshold
ben: keep eyes, if p99 crosses 250ms mark escalate by tagging me and sam
carol: hitting safepoint at shard 120, pausing 30s to checkpoint, continuing after checkpoint
alice: thanks — logging this into release notes and the post-deploy doc
sam: FINISHED monitoring window 00:27 UTC. no escalation, rollback NOT triggered. will leave pager on for 1hr for drift watch
ben: thanks all — I'll open a follow-up PR to unblock analytics once we've let traffic settle. :party_parrot:
